caption: Crusoe announced a $3.9 billion Series F on Thursday, lifting its valuation to $30.9 billion — up from $10 billion just ten months ago. The round was co-led by Atreides Management, Mubadala Capital, and Valor Equity Partners, with Nvidia, Founders Fund, GIC, the Qatar Investment Authority, Radical Ventures, and TPG also participating. Alongside the raise, Crusoe unveiled Spark, a line of modular data centers that ship by flatbed truck and connect to power almost anywhere, with no large construction workforce required. Bloomberg separately reported a $13 billion, five-year cloud contract with quantitative trading firm Jane Street. Axios reported last month that Crusoe had already met with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley to discuss a potential IPO.
